items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: And I played with little local bands, such as The Chic and... And this fellow with blue so large, Sam...

ctx.x: Any of your brothers play in the band? No, no.
Not with me during those times. During those times. And I played with little local bands, such as The Chic and... And this fellow with blue so large, Sam... Sam who? Sam...
